biography.plain_text: Michael Alan Guerrieri, known as Alan, is an American poultry businessman and former president of Showell Farms. He joined his father’s Maryland business, expanded it over four decades and developed an integrated poultry operation before its sale to Perdue Farms in 1995. He later moved to Florida with his family.

long_biography.plain_text:
Care that Michael Alan Guerrieri and his wife Patricia received at Holy Cross Hospital helped shape their support for healthcare in Fort Lauderdale. The couple gave to its capital campaign, and after Patricia’s death the family foundation funded a women’s health pavilion in her memory. The facility combined clinical services with counselling and practical education on nutrition and healthy living.

His connection with Salisbury University was personal: he first met Patricia outside Holloway Hall while she was a student. Their scholarship endowment and later science research fund provided hundreds of awards to students. After the poultry business sale, the family established its charitable foundation, concentrating its giving on health and education in Maryland and Florida.
